description: Interpret a test run: pass, no-tests, skipped, flaky, infra-failure from runner, exit code and counts — Reads a finished test run (runner, exit code, optional version, flags, caller-parsed counts, optional go test output, optional per-attempt exit codes) and says whether tests actually passed, ran nothing, were all skipped, passed only on retry, or never ran properly (timeout, signal, internal error). Encodes only exit-code semantics the runners document: pytest 0-5, node:test, mocha (failure count

attemptExitCodes.description: Exit codes of repeated runs of the same tests, to detect flakiness. Interpreted with the same runner rules.

counts.description: Counts parsed by the caller from the runner's own report.

flaky.description: Tests that failed then passed on retry.

exitCode.description: Process exit status. Omit when the process was killed by a signal or timed out.

output.description: go test output (only ok, FAIL, --- FAIL and panic: lines are read).

timedOut.description: True when the harness gave up waiting.

version.description: Runner version, e.g. 10.4.0. Needed only for version-gated flags.

name: test-exit-interpret
